name: Insurance Claims
summary: Property repair and reconstruction for approved insurance scopes involving hail, wind, roofing, water and interior damage. Luna General Contractors helps homeowners move from the insurer's repair estimate to a coordinated construction plan and completed build-back.
features: Review of approved insurance repair scopes
Roofing, siding, fascia and exterior restoration
Drywall, texture, paint and trim replacement
Coordination of multiple trades through completion

faqs.question: Do you act as a public adjuster?
faqs.answer: No. Luna General Contractors is a construction company. We prepare construction estimates, review repair scopes and complete approved repairs, while coverage decisions and policy interpretation remain with the insurer and policyholder.

faqs.question: Can you work from an insurance company estimate?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can review the approved construction scope, compare it with visible site conditions and organize the roofing, exterior or interior repairs included in the project.

faqs.question: What types of insurance-related repairs do you handle?
faqs.answer: Projects may include hail and wind repairs, roofing, siding, fascia, drywall, ceilings, texture, painting, trim, flooring, cabinets and water-damage reconstruction after the property has been stabilized.

faqs.question: Can one contractor coordinate several approved trades?
faqs.answer: Yes. When the approved scope involves multiple trades, we can coordinate the construction sequence so roofing, drywall, paint, trim, flooring and related repairs are completed under one project plan.
